'''''Wonders of the Galaxy''''' was an exhibition room during the auction of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] with copies of many [[Wonders of the Galaxy/Legends|Wonders of the Galaxy]] in the [[Figg & Associates Art Museum]] located in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
